mapper.sql: customer_contacts.id AS id, customers.id AS organizationId, customers.name AS organizationName, customer_contacts.photo AS photo, customer_contacts.sex AS gender, customer_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, customer_contacts.position AS `position`, customer_contacts.contact_telephone AS contactTelephone, customer_contacts.contact_email AS contactEmail, customer_contacts.note AS note, customer_contacts.is_apply AS isApply, customer_contacts.age AS age, customer_contact_familys.id AS familyId, customer_contact_familys.name AS familyName, customer_contact_locations.id AS locationId, customer_contact_locations.name AS locationName, employee_personalities.id AS characterId, employee_personalities.name AS characterName, customer_contacts.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, customer_contacts.modified AS modified, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM customer_contacts LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = customer_contacts.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON modifier.id = customer_contacts.modified_by LEFT JOIN customers ON customers.id = customer_contacts.customer_id AND customers.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customer_contact_familys ON customer_contact_familys.id = customer_contacts.family_id AND customer_contact_familys.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN customer_contact_locations ON customer_contact_locations.id = customer_contacts.location_id AND customer_contact_locations.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN employee_personalities ON employee_personalities.id = customer_contacts.character_id AND employee_personalities.is_active = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_contacts SET `photo` = #{customerContact.photo}, `customer_id` = #{customerContact.organizationId}, `contact_name` = #{customerContact.contactName}, `sex` = #{customerContact.gender}, `contact_telephone` = #{customerContact.contactTelephone}, `contact_email` = #{customerContact.contactEmail}, `position` = #{customerContact.position}, `note` = #{customerContact.note}, `family_id` = #{customerContact.familyId}, `age` = #{customerContact.age}, `dob` = #{customerContact.dob}, `location_id` = #{customerContact.locationId}, `character_id` = #{customerContact.characterId}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{customerContact.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{customerContact.id} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE customer_contacts SET is_active = 2, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT `customer_description_type_id` AS id, `customer_contact_description_types`.name, `description` FROM customer_contact_descriptions INNER JOIN customer_contact_description_types ON customer_contact_descriptions.customer_description_type_id = customer_contact_description_types.id AND customer_contact_description_types.is_active = 1 WHERE `customer_contact_id` = #{customerContactId}

SELECT customer_contact_pregress.`customer_progress_detail_id` AS id, customer_contact_pregress_details.name AS name, customer_contact_progress_types.id AS typeId, customer_contact_progress_types.name AS typeName, customer_contact_pregress.`percent` AS percent FROM customer_contact_pregress INNER JOIN customer_contact_pregress_details ON customer_contact_pregress.customer_progress_detail_id = customer_contact_pregress_details.id AND customer_contact_pregress_details.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN customer_contact_progress_types ON customer_contact_pregress_details.customer_progress_type_id = customer_contact_progress_types.id AND customer_contact_progress_types.is_active = 1 WHERE `customer_contact_id` = #{customerContactId}

SELECT `customer_contact_lists`.customer_list_detail_id AS id, `customer_contact_list_details`.name AS name, `customer_contact_list_types`.id AS typeId, `customer_contact_list_types`.name AS typeName FROM customer_contact_lists INNER JOIN customer_contact_list_details ON customer_contact_lists.customer_list_detail_id = customer_contact_list_details.id AND customer_contact_list_details.is_active = 1 INNER JOIN customer_contact_list_types ON customer_contact_list_details.customer_list_type_id = customer_contact_list_types.id AND customer_contact_list_types.is_active = 1 WHERE `customer_contact_id` = #{customerContactId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_contact_nps ( company_id, `customer_id`, `customer_contact_id`, `score`, created, created_by ) VALUES ( (SELECT company_id FROM customer_companies WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_contacts WHERE id = #{customerContactId}) LIMIT 1), (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_contacts WHERE id = #{customerContactId}), #{customerContactId}, #{score}, NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_contacts SET is_apply = 1 WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{id}
